scripts.dev:services: npm run build -w @mira/protocol && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @mira/server" "npm run dev -w @mira/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mira/protocol && npm run build -w @mira/server && npm run build -w @mira/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @mira/protocol && npm run build -w @mira/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @mira/protocol && npm run build -w @mira/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mira/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:runtime && npm run assets:check
